svg.text: trex-web-gui does not start TRex: start the TRex server in stateless mode first, then run trex-web-gui as an ordinary user (no root). Single-user:

svg.text: every logged-in tab shares the one TRex session, and each start makes a new login URL. TRex still listens on 4501/4500 (and the daemon on 8090) on
